voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: Far, far away, on a shining planet called Zootellia, a baby girl named Luna was born. Luna was special. She was born with starlight power inside her — power that could never, ever be taken away. You could not steal it. You could not drain it. It was hers, and it grew brighter every time she was brave. Everyone in the galaxy wanted that power. But you could only reach Zootellia if you had powers too — or if you brought a friend who did. Luna's mum was the kind Queen of Zootellia. She had a tall gold crown and a long, flowing cape, and when she needed to be brave, she could turn into a great golden lion.

voice.name: en-GB-LibbyNeural
voice.prosody: "You don't have to be anyone but yourself, Luna,"

voice.name: en-GB-LibbyNeural
voice.prosody: "That is where your power comes from."

voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: When Luna was three, she met her very best friend in the whole universe — a small, round bunny called Cheeto. Cheeto had floppy ears that faded from white at the top to bright pink at the tips. He had a tiny star on his head and a little camera on his collar. And when Cheeto wiggled his ears — bzzzt! — he could give a buzzy little zap. He could even do karate. Cheeto loved Luna, and Luna loved Cheeto.
